analysis.title: The Globalizer: The Midterms and Their Implications
key_insights: Democrats won majorities in both the House and Senate in the midterms, shifting the balance of power in Washington. Citi's Macro to Micro report assesses implications for AI spending, fiscal policy and foreign policy.
Citi introduces an Emerging Markets Regime Model that classifies the EM macro backdrop into five stages: Recession, Stagflation, Goldilocks, Overheating and Transition.
From the EEI conference: data-center growth will continue in states that can address public opposition through deals that protect utilities and consumers in downside scenarios.
Citi downgrades Roblox (RBLX) to Neutral and leaves its $55 target price unchanged. Near-term concerns include the waning popularity of Steal an Egg and fourth-quarter bookings.
European Media enters 2027 in two-way debate territory after a resilient earnings season and a favorable shift in AI positioning.
U.S. Equity Strategy: third-quarter earnings were solid but not exceptional, signaling a move from recent quarters' extraordinary earnings tailwinds toward a "new normal" for 2027.

Recent AI-related weakness has revived comparisons with past bubble peaks. Citi identifies three warning signs that have historically appeared around major market peaks, and notes that leadership rotations often show up before broader weakness is visible.
A Citi Markets Edition podcast discusses a "triple whammy" that has hit U.S. rates and how investors should respond.
